title: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
shortDescription: A top-down adventure that uses changes in scale to make familiar rooms, towns, and dungeon spaces feel newly surprising.
highlights: Shrinking transforms ordinary scenery into readable exploratory puzzles
Dungeons pair clear action with a steady stream of spatial discoveries
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A high-value Game Boy Advance adventure selection for its inventive scale mechanic and friendly pacing.
